name: Berggasthof Kölnberg
beschreibung: The Berggasthof Kölnberg is located in the municipality of Ebbs in Tirol. The inn is situated in a quiet location with a view of the Kaisergebirge. The accommodation offers simple rooms with Tiroler-style furnishings. The restaurant serves Austrian cuisine. The inn is a suitable starting point for hikes in the Kaisergebirge. In winter, skiers can use the surrounding areas. The regional cuisine is the focus.
